config.purpose: register uniform training shapes after varied-shape physical-footprint failure

hypothesis: mlx-lm compiles its gradient step for each 32-token sequence bucket; the full variable-length run accumulates much more process footprint than the repeated longest-example probe. This is unproven until measured.
change: Right-pad only training batches to 1025 tokens (1024 inputs), and gather the answer projection by each row actual end length so all original supervised tokens and gradients remain unchanged. Keep the 7 GiB guard and 256 MiB free-cache bound.
probe: 32 microbatches / 16 optimizer updates, full unchanged train data/order, two validation examples, seed 3; discard probe weights before the full recipe.
full_launcher_source:
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from safetensors.numpy import load_file
from makemarket.provenance import receipt

pid = int(Path('runs/qwen35_uniform_probe.pid').read_text())
while True:
    try:
        os.kill(pid, 0)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        break
    time.sleep(5)
training = json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen35_uniform_smoke.json').read_text())
guard = json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen35_uniform_memory_guard.json').read_text())
assert training['status'] == guard['status'] == 'completed'
assert training['optimizer_updates'] == 16
initial = 'train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft-interrupted/best.safetensors'
updated = 'train/runs/qwen35-uniform-smoke/adapters.safetensors'
a, b = load_file(initial), load_file(updated)
assert a.keys() == b.keys()
deltas = [float(np.abs(a[k].astype(np.float32)-b[k].astype(np.float32)).max()) for k in a]
assert any(d > 0 for d in deltas)
r = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose':'verify sixteen uniform-shape updates before full restart'},training['model_revision']),
     'tensors_checked':len(deltas),'tensors_changed':sum(d>0 for d in deltas),
     'maximum_absolute_parameter_delta':max(deltas),
     'initial_adapter_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(initial).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
     'updated_adapter_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(updated).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
     'calculation_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
Path('results/training/qwen35_uniform_probe_verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
del a, b, deltas
model = str(Path.home()/'.cache/mmb_models/Qwen3.5-4B-MLX-4bit')
revision = '32f3e8ecf65426fc3306969496342d504bfa13f3'
command = ['bash','scripts/with_resource.sh','heavy-ml','.venv/bin/python','-u','train/with_memory_guard.py',
           '--result','results/training/qwen35_sft_memory.json','.venv/bin/python','-u','train/mlx_train.py',
           '--model',model,'--revision',revision,'--resume',initial,'--out','train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft',
           '--result','results/training/qwen35_sft.json','--answer-head-tokens','128','--pad-training-to','1025']
subprocess.run(command,check=True)
shutil.copyfile('train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft/best.safetensors','train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft/adapters.safetensors')
subprocess.run(['bash','scripts/with_resource.sh','heavy-ml','.venv/bin/python','-u','train/mlx_evaluate.py',
                '--model',model,'--revision',revision,'--adapter','train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft',
                '--label','qwen3.5-4b-sft','--seed','80000','--episodes','100','--out','results/validation/qwen35-sft'],check=True)
